title: ilex paltoria
intro: Ilex paltoria, commonly known as American Winterberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Aquifoliaceae. The health benefits of Ilex paltoria include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Ilex paltoria, such as queretin and isorhapontigenin, may contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
